props.text: Holiday Manager demo — EDITS ARE REAL: data.holidays binds the gateway's holiday list (system.user.getHolidays(); the binding seeds two demo holidays), and the onHolidaySave / onHolidayDelete scripts persist via system.user. The rail sorts by NEXT occurrence (past one-offs sink and dim); schedules with 'Observes holidays' enabled are inactive on these dates. Edit the name/date/repeat, then Save; '+ New holiday' creates one; Delete asks twice.

config.script:
# Reference persistence: rebuild a HolidayModel and write it back —
	# addHoliday when new, else editHoliday under the OLD name on a rename.
	import sys
	from com.inductiveautomation.ignition.common.user.schedule import HolidayModel
	s = event.holiday
	name = str(s.name)
	try:
		d = system.date.parse(str(s.date), 'yyyy-MM-dd')
		try:
			m = HolidayModel(name, d, bool(s.repeatAnnually))
		except:
			m = HolidayModel()
			m.name = name
			m.date = d
			m.repeatAnnually = bool(s.repeatAnnually)
		old = None
		try:
			old = event.oldName
		except:
			old = None
		if bool(event.isNew):
			resp = system.user.addHoliday(m)
			action = 'created "' + name + '"'
		elif old and str(old) != name:
			resp = system.user.editHoliday(str(old), m)
			action = 'renamed "' + str(old) + '" -> "' + name + '"'
		else:
			resp = system.user.editHoliday(name, m)
			action = 'persisted "' + name + '"'
		errs = [str(x) for x in resp.getErrors()]
		if errs:
			self.view.custom.lastEvent = 'onHolidaySave ERRORS: ' + '; '.join(errs)
		else:
			self.view.custom.lastEvent = 'onHolidaySave ' + action
	except:
		self.view.custom.lastEvent = 'onHolidaySave FAILED: ' + str(sys.exc_info()[1])
	self.view.custom.refreshTick = self.view.custom.refreshTick + 1
